PRESS RELEASE
February 23, 1999

MEDICAL MARIJUANA CLASS ACTION LAWSUIT

Meet the people behind this historic Class Action lawsuit.

The first public hearing on the peoples Action Class For Therapeutic Cannabis will be on 3 March, 1999 in United States District Court Eastern District of Pennsylvania in Philadelphia.

Plaintiff-patients from across the country are assembling in Philadelphia to be visible in their determination for their rightful need of therapeutic cannabis and will be in attendance in the courtroom on March 3. Of the 165 original plaintiffs at least 100 are expected to be present for the first public court hearing.

Many of the plaintiff-patients are disabled and in grave pain, both physical from their medical conditions and psychological from the prohibition of therapeutic cannabis.

Their assemblage in Philadelphia will represent a compelling and dramatic exposure surrounding the issues of marijuana prohibition and medical compassion. Their assemblage in Philadelphia comes by way of great hardship - many patients traveling in vans with their attendants or flying on a week’s notice with their attendants and many in wheelchairs. They all understand the critical Constitutional issues involved by the government’s arbitrary imposition of a prohibition on cannabis, and are determined to lend their physical presence to this auspicious event.

Following the court hearing there will be a press conference featuring the patients who have traveled from every part of the country to attend the hearing. Individual patients will be available for interview following the press conference.

The Press Conference will be held at:
Colleen’s
Park Town Place, South Building
2200 Benjamin Franklin Parkway
Philadelphia, PA 19130
Information on the Class Action suit can be viewed online at http://www.fairlaw.org
